lines: The trail is a trail again. Rock, snow, a bit of a slither, and no glass on it anywhere.
I went back up to the second cairn on Sunday with the rope in my bag and did not take it out.
I am going to keep carrying it. That is what the last month is worth to me.
I went up to the second cairn and I came down on my back for the last of it.
Rain. Freezing on as it landed. The whole trail was glass by the afternoon.
I have walked that trail since I was nine. I have never once needed a rope on it.
Nothing broken. Just cold, and cold makes you stupid, and stupid is the injury.
They keep you here until you can do the seven times table. That is the actual test.
Four beds, and two of them are always for the mountain. That is not pessimism.
It is two beds. It costs this town two beds a year to be somewhere people come back to.
